ROHAN SINGH

Senior RPA Developer | Power Automate | Automation Anywhere | Power Platform Ahmedabad / Bengaluru, India Phone: +91 75748 62380 | Email: rohansingh7574@gmail.com LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/rohan-singh-613582203

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior RPA Developer with 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise-grade automation solutions across Banking, Financial Services, Healthcare, Telecom, and Engineering domains. Strong expertise in Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Automation Anywhere (A360, IQ Bot, AARI), and Power Platform. Proven experience in end-to-end process automation, API integrations, unattended bots on Virtual Machines, AI Builder–based document processing, production deployments, and migration projects. Adept at building secure, scalable, and compliant automation solutions aligned with business objectives.

CORE SKILLS

Robotic Process Automation (RPA) | Microsoft Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop) | Automation Anywhere A360 | IQ Bot | AARI | Power Platform | Dataverse | Copilot Studio | AI Builder | Banking & Financial Services Automation | Healthcare & Insurance Automation | REST APIs | JSON | XML | SFTP | Virtual Machines | Unattended Bots | Work Queues | Power BI | SQL | SQLite | UAT | SIT | Production Support | Hypercare | Agile | SDLC

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer – RPA Developer | Ness Digital Engineering Dec 2024 – Present | Project: Canadian Bank & Financial Services (cid:127) Automated end-to-end banking processes using Power Automate Cloud flows and Power Automate Desktop. (cid:127) Integrated automation with SharePoint, Dataverse, Office 365, Dynamics 365, SQL using Power Platform connectors. (cid:127) Designed and deployed unattended RPA bots on Virtual Machines (VMs) enabling secure 24×7 execution. (cid:127) Automated legacy applications and emulators (PComm) using Power Automate Desktop UI automation. (cid:127) Built Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents) chatbots integrated with Power Automate and Microsoft Teams. (cid:127) Implemented AI Builder document processing models reducing manual validation efforts. (cid:127) Developed Power BI dashboards to monitor automation performance, failures, and SLA compliance. (cid:127) Followed Power Platform governance, security roles, and environment strategy for compliant delivery.

Software Engineer – RPA Developer | Sunflower Solutions Pvt. Ltd May 2023 – Nov 2024 | Domain: Healthcare & Insurance Automation Waystar VOB Automation (cid:127) Automated Verification of Benefits (VOB) using Power Automate Cloud flows integrated with Waystar insurance APIs, reducing manual insurance verification by ~60%. Cadwell Automation (ZinniaX Integration) (cid:127) Developed Power Automate Desktop workflows on Virtual Machines for ZinniaX desktop application. (cid:127) Automated secure SFTP file downloads and transfers using Power Automate connectors. Cadwell JSON Extraction (cid:127) Automated healthcare data extraction and transformation into structured JSON using Power Automate and PAD. (cid:127) Integrated JSON outputs with Cadwell systems and downstream platforms. Coding Bot (cid:127) Built rule-based automation using APIs to update labels and statuses. Standard of Care Automation (cid:127) Automated patient and physician data retrieval using Power Automate APIs to evaluate eligibility and compliance.

Reader Pay Automation (cid:127) Automated doctor and surgeon compensation calculations using Power Automate, Dataverse, and SQL. Responsibilities Across Projects (cid:127) Performed process analysis, solution design, development, testing, UAT, and production deployment. (cid:127) Provided production support, issue resolution, optimization, and end-user training.

Software Engineer – RPA Developer | Tecnoprism Pvt. Ltd Mar 2022 – May 2023 (cid:127) Designed and developed Automation Anywhere bots for enterprise processes. (cid:127) Executed Automation Anywhere v11 to A360 migration projects. (cid:127) Deployed bots in UAT and Production with extended hypercare support.

Python & Django Developer | Brainy Beams Technologies Pvt. Ltd Jun 2021 – Mar 2022 (cid:127) Developed backend components using Python and Django. (cid:127) Contributed to Zacson Health & Fitness platform.

EDUCATION

Master of Computer Applications (MCA) – Monark University Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) – Gujarat University

CERTIFICATIONS

Automation Anywhere Master Certification Automation Anywhere Advanced Certification Python & Django Development – Brainy Beams Technologies Python Certification – Coding Ninjas
